title: Streams to the Lake
description: Hands-on: land a Kafka stream in an object-store data lake. Connect Pentaho Data Integration to MinIO with a VFS connection, write each batch of pdi-signups records as an Avro file with Avro output, see how the batch size sets the number and size of the files, read a batch back in Pentaho Data Integration, and read the whole lake with another engine.
